home.headline: I'm Hamza Al Halabi. I build biomedical prototypes and software for lab data.
home.sub: Biomedical engineering student at the University of Cincinnati. Co-op at Live Well Collaborative since August 2026.

lungscope.line: Prepares lung-sound recordings for training, with 854 known subjects kept in separate splits.

arch-support.line: Our team bench-tested a sewn arch sleeve with gel pads.

ecg.line: I soldered the board and wrote its Processing monitor.
ecg.lede: I soldered an ECG board and wrote the Processing monitor that draws its trace.
ecg.detail: The Arduino loop includes a 10 ms delay, giving a nominal rate near 100 Hz. Processing draws the latest reading and estimates rate from flagged threshold crossings.

mass-spec.line: An Excel/VBA macro that turns mass-spec exports into t-tests and volcano plots.

jobhub.line: A private job-search tool that does not submit applications for you.

notes.heroTrace: synthetic squiggle, not a real recording
notes.lungscopeAudio: browser-generated noise, not a lung recording

about: I'm studying biomedical engineering at the University of Cincinnati and on co-op at Live Well Collaborative. My projects include an ECG monitor, a pediatric arch sleeve and software for lab data. Other work includes GRASP Studio.
